Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take to get a quote?

We review all quote requests and respond within 24 hours with detailed pricing based on your film selection and measurements.

Do I need exact measurements?

Approximate measurements are fine for an initial quote. We confirm exact dimensions during the free on-site assessment before installation.

Can I request a specific film brand?

Yes. We install 3M, LLumar, Madico, Solar Gard, Huper Optik, Solyx, and more. If you have a specific film in mind, note it in your request or select it from the film dropdown.

Is the quote free?

Yes. All quotes from Arizona House of Film are free with no obligation. Licensed ROC #314088.
